pick.name: Claude Project 'voice & style' + Harper
pick.what: A Claude Project holding your voice guide and best past posts for drafting; Harper as a local grammar checker in Chrome/Edge, VS Code and Obsidian
pick.why: Drafting quality comes from Claude (owned); Harper is free, open source and fully local, so nothing you type (incl. client info) goes to a grammar cloud
pick.windows_fit: web (Chrome/Edge/Firefox extensions) + VS Code + Obsidian plugin
pick.install: Chrome Web Store 'Harper'; Obsidian community plugin 'Harper'

alts.what: Cloud grammar/tone assistant, now with Superhuman Go AI
alts.why: Best tone rewrites; cloud processing; paid features moved into Superhuman bundles
alts.free_limits: Free tier status for 2026 not verified; Pro $12/mo annual (reported)

alts.name: Gemini in Gmail/Docs (Help me write, Proofread)
alts.what: Owned writing help inside Google apps

candidates.name: Claude Project + Harper
candidates.verdict: PICK: owned AI + free local checker

decision: Write with Claude using a dedicated voice Project and check with Harper, which is local and free. Grammarly only wins if you want tone rewriting everywhere and accept cloud processing.

verify.note: Harper Apache-2.0, v3.0.0 released 27 Oct 2026 (GitHub releases page).
